_comment: Reviewed list of Mac-only menu/control labels that are never a Lulo gap: OS chrome, iCloud-only features, and services Lulo has deliberately not promised. `app` is "*" for every app or a Lulo app display name. `match` is "exact" (default) or "prefix". Add rows here only after a human confirms the item is genuinely out of scope, with a reason a reviewer can check.

entries.label: AutoFill
entries.reason: AppKit's AutoFill submenu uses macOS Contacts, Passwords and protected payment-card providers.

entries.label: Contact…
entries.reason: Contact AutoFill reads the Apple Contacts store.

entries.label: Passwords…
entries.reason: Password AutoFill reads Apple Passwords and iCloud Keychain.

entries.label: Credit Card…
entries.reason: Payment-card AutoFill reads Apple's protected card store.

entries.label: <<Import From Device - unlocalized>>
entries.reason: TextEdit's Import From Device invokes Apple's Continuity service for an iPhone or iPad.

entries.label: Share
entries.reason: This opens macOS's system Share sheet for AirDrop, Messages, Mail and Apple share extensions; Lulo has no Apple Share service.

entries.label: No Document
entries.reason: AppKit inserts this disabled placeholder into the empty Revert To and Share submenus; it is not an action.

entries.label: Apple
entries.reason: The system Apple menu is OS chrome (About This Mac, System Settings…, Sleep/Restart/Shut Down, Recent Items, App Store updates), not part of any app's own menu bar. Lulo's shell has no per-app equivalent slot for it.

entries.label: SF Mono Regular 11
entries.reason: SF Mono is an Apple font; Lulo uses its bundled monospace font and exposes the font size separately.

entries.label: Menlo Regular 11
entries.reason: Menlo is an Apple font; Lulo uses its bundled monospace font and exposes the font size separately.

entries.label: Services
entries.reason: Services is populated system-wide from every installed app's Info.plist; Lulo has no Services architecture and nothing to port.

entries.label: AutoFill
entries.reason: AppKit's AutoFill submenu belongs to macOS's system Contacts and Passwords services, which System Monitor cannot access on Linux.

entries.label: Contact…
entries.reason: Opens a macOS Contacts AutoFill picker tied to the user's Apple Contacts data.

entries.label: Passwords…
entries.reason: Opens the macOS Passwords AutoFill picker backed by Apple Passwords and iCloud Keychain.

entries.label: Credit Card…
entries.reason: Opens macOS's protected payment-card AutoFill picker backed by Apple Wallet or Safari data.

entries.label: Run Spindump
entries.reason: Runs Apple's macOS spindump utility and produces a .spin report, neither of which exists on Linux.

entries.label: Run System Diagnostics…
entries.reason: Invokes Apple's macOS sysdiagnose collection and its proprietary report format.

entries.label: Recent Items
entries.reason: AppKit's own Recent Items submenu under the Apple menu (the app's own File > Open Recent is tracked separately and is NOT allowlisted).

entries.label: AirDrop
entries.reason: AirDrop requires Apple's nearby-device transfer service.

entries.label: iCloud Drive
entries.reason: iCloud Drive requires Apple Account cloud storage.

entries.label: Store your Desktop & Documents folders in iCloud Drive and access them from your other devices.
entries.reason: This setting moves local folders into Apple Account iCloud storage.

entries.label: Import from iPhone
entries.reason: Continuity import requires Apple's iPhone device services.

entries.label: Select Startup Disk
entries.reason: This selects a macOS boot volume through Apple's Startup Disk service.

entries.label: Mac User Guide
entries.reason: This opens Apple's macOS user guide.

entries.label: Tips for Your Mac
entries.reason: This opens Apple's Mac tips service.

entries.label: App Store…
entries.reason: This searches Apple's App Store for an application to open the selected file.

entries.label: Books
entries.reason: Books is Apple's macOS ebook application and is not available on Lulo.

entries.label: ColorSync Utility
entries.reason: ColorSync Utility is Apple's macOS colour-profile application and is not available on Lulo.

entries.label: Safari
entries.reason: Safari is Apple's browser and is not available on Lulo.

entries.reason: This submenu uses Apple's Contacts, Passwords and payment-card providers.

entries.label: Contact…
entries.reason: Contact AutoFill reads the Apple Contacts store.

entries.label: Passwords…

entries.label: Credit Card…
entries.reason: Payment-card AutoFill reads Apple's protected card store.

entries.label: Start Dictation…
entries.reason: Apple dictation (on-device/cloud speech-to-text) is an Apple Intelligence/Siri feature with no Linux equivalent shipped yet.

entries.label: Emoji & Symbols
entries.reason: The macOS character viewer is a system input-method feature, not an app menu command; Lulo has its own emoji picker reachable another way (tracked separately in docs/parity.md, not here).

entries.label: Share…
entries.reason: macOS Share sheets hand off to iCloud/AirDrop/Mail/Messages/social extensions. Lulo has no share-sheet architecture; this is a standing, intentionally-deferred gap tracked as a whole in docs/parity.md rather than per occurrence here.

entries.label: Add to Dock
entries.reason: macOS-specific Dock integration for files, distinct from Lulo's own Dock (which already pins apps); porting "add a file alias to the Dock" is not planned.

entries.label: Make Alias
entries.reason: Classic Mac OS aliases (resolved by Finder/the OS at open time) have no Linux filesystem equivalent; Lulo would need symlinks instead, tracked as a design question in docs/parity.md, not a straight menu-item port.

entries.label: Compress using Keka
entries.reason: Injected by the Keka Finder Sync extension installed on the reference Mac, not by stock Finder. Any third-party Finder extension's rows are machine-specific and never a Lulo gap; re-check this list if the reference Mac's installed extensions change.

entries.label: Extract using Keka
entries.reason: See "Compress using Keka": the Keka Finder Sync extension, not stock Finder.

entries.label: Send to Keka
entries.reason: See "Compress using Keka": the Keka Finder Sync extension, not stock Finder.

entries.label: Fill
entries.reason: Window ▸ Fill's Mac shortcut is fn⌃F, shown by Accessibility as the plain ⌃F it also is for Centre and Move & Resize (fn does not expose as an AX modifier). PC keyboards have no Globe/fn key, so Lulo's keyd layer substitutes ⌘ for it (ADR 0017, docs/decisions/0017-mac-keyboard.md); bare ⌃-only chords for this family also matter for the arrow keys, where niri already binds ⌃←/→/↑/↓ to Mission Control's Spaces (packaging/rmac-session/shell.kdl), so the whole group keeps the same ⌃⌘ pattern for consistency (WIN-01, docs/parity.md).

entries.label: Centre
entries.reason: Window ▸ Centre's Mac shortcut is fn⌃C, shown by Accessibility as the plain ⌃C fn does not expose as an AX modifier. PC keyboards have no Globe/fn key, so Lulo's keyd layer substitutes ⌘ for it (ADR 0017); see the Fill entry above for the rest of this family's reasoning (WIN-01, docs/parity.md).

entries.label: Left
entries.reason: Window ▸ Move & Resize ▸ Left's Mac shortcut is fn⌃←, shown by Accessibility as plain ⌃←. niri already binds bare ⌃← to Mission Control's "Previous Space" (packaging/rmac-session/shell.kdl), and PC keyboards have no Globe/fn key to tell the two apart, so Lulo's keyd layer uses ⌃⌘← instead (ADR 0017, WIN-01 in docs/parity.md).

entries.label: Right
entries.reason: Window ▸ Move & Resize ▸ Right's Mac shortcut is fn⌃→, shown by Accessibility as plain ⌃→. niri already binds bare ⌃→ to Mission Control's "Next Space", and PC keyboards have no Globe/fn key to tell the two apart, so Lulo's keyd layer uses ⌃⌘→ instead (ADR 0017, WIN-01 in docs/parity.md).

entries.label: Top
entries.reason: Window ▸ Move & Resize ▸ Top's Mac shortcut is fn⌃↑, shown by Accessibility as plain ⌃↑. niri already binds bare ⌃↑ to Mission Control itself, and PC keyboards have no Globe/fn key to tell the two apart, so Lulo's keyd layer uses ⌃⌘↑ instead (ADR 0017, WIN-01 in docs/parity.md).

entries.label: App Nap
entries.reason: App Nap is a macOS process-throttling state reported by AppKit; Linux has no per-process App Nap state to measure.

entries.label: Sudden Termination
entries.reason: Sudden Termination is an AppKit lifecycle opt-in flag; Linux processes do not publish that flag.

entries.label: Purgeable Memory
entries.reason: This is the macOS VM purgeable allocation class, which Linux does not expose per process.

entries.label: Fill
entries.reason: Window ▸ Fill's Mac shortcut is fn⌃F, shown by Accessibility as the plain ⌃F it also is for Centre and Move & Resize (fn does not expose as an AX modifier). PC keyboards have no Globe/fn key, so Lulo's keyd layer substitutes ⌘ for it (ADR 0017, docs/decisions/0017-mac-keyboard.md); bare ⌃-only chords for this family also matter for the arrow keys, where niri already binds ⌃←/→/↑/↓ to Mission Control's Spaces (packaging/rmac-session/shell.kdl), so the whole group keeps the same ⌃⌘ pattern for consistency (WIN-01, docs/parity.md).

PC keyboards have no Globe/fn key, so Lulo's keyd layer substitutes ⌘ for it (ADR 0017); see the Fill entry above for the rest of this family's reasoning (WIN-01, docs/parity.md).

PC keyboards have no Globe/fn key, so Lulo's keyd layer uses ⌃⇧⌘R instead, matching the rest of this family (ADR 0017, WIN-01 in docs/parity.md).

entries.label: Time Machine
entries.reason: Time Machine is Apple's backup engine (APFS snapshots, Time Machine volumes); Lulo has no backup engine yet and does not show a pane that cannot back up. Tracked as SET-10 in docs/parity.md.

entries.label: Startup Disk
entries.reason: Startup Disk picks which macOS volume the Mac firmware boots; a single-OS Lulo PC boots through its own firmware/GRUB, so the pane would have nothing true to change (SET-10).

entries.label: Transfer or Reset
entries.reason: Transfer or Reset runs Apple's Migration Assistant and Erase All Content and Settings for Apple hardware; Lulo has neither a migration service nor a safe factory reset (SET-10).

entries.label: Touch ID & Password
entries.reason: Lulo has no Touch ID. The same password row lives in the Login Password pane, the name macOS 26 gives this pane on a Mac without Touch ID (SET-05).

entries.label: Allow blinking text
entries.reason: alacritty_terminal 0.25.1's Term::terminal_attribute (term/mod.rs) silently discards vte::ansi::Attr::BlinkSlow/BlinkFast/CancelBlink into its catch-all arm, so Lulo's terminal grid never learns a cell is blinking. Tracking it correctly needs a wrapping Handler that wraps every one of Term's ~50 overridden methods (to avoid silently reverting any of them to the trait's no-op default) plus a focus-gated blink timer gated on at least one blinking cell being visible — a larger, dedicated change than fits this pass, not a toggle that would do nothing (TRM-SETTINGS-004).

entries.label: Antialias text
entries.reason: The pinned gpui (=0.2.2) exposes no public per-window or per-text-run API to toggle text antialiasing on the Linux backend; the only antialiasing switches found (`set_should_antialias`/`set_allows_antialiasing`) are macOS-only CoreText calls. Changing it would mean patching the vendored Linux backend (ADR 0013), out of scope here (TRM-SETTINGS-005).

entries.label: Background
entries.reason: Mac Terminal's Background control is a colour well plus an opacity slider that lets the desktop or windows behind Terminal show through. Lulo's profile backgrounds are opaque; real alpha-blended window transparency needs Wayland compositor/window-surface support that hasn't been verified on niri (the same dependency the brief names for background blur), so this is left out rather than faked with an in-window-only fade that wouldn't actually be transparent (TRM-SETTINGS-006).

entries.label: Change…
entries.reason: This button opens the Mac font-family picker; Terminal ▸ Settings… ▸ Font already exposes the font *size* stepper (⌘+/⌘−/⌘0 and the Settings window), but choosing a different monospace font family is a separate, unscoped feature (TRM-SETTINGS-009).

entries.label: Dynamic foreground colours
entries.reason: This exists to keep text legible over a custom background image or a translucent window showing variable content behind it. Lulo has neither background images nor real window transparency (see the Background/Image: rows above), so there is nothing for this toggle to actually change yet — adding it now would be a no-op fake control (TRM-SETTINGS-012).

entries.label: Encodings
entries.reason: Lulo's terminal always decodes PTY output as UTF-8. The hot per-byte segmentation path in emulator.rs (advance_filtered_output) assumes UTF-8 scalar boundaries to safely split reads across the vte parser; adding a second legacy 8-bit encoding (e.g. ISO-8859-1) without risking that default path needs touching the session-reader thread, the output filter and the emulator together — a larger, dedicated change than fits this pass (TRM-SETTINGS-013).

entries.label: Help
entries.reason: Opens Apple's Terminal help book via Help Viewer; Linux has no equivalent help-book viewer or content to show (TRM-SETTINGS-014).

entries.label: Image:
entries.reason: Lets a profile use a custom background image instead of a solid colour. Not implemented — see the Background row above for the same transparency/compositing dependency, plus a file-picker and image-compositing feature of its own (TRM-SETTINGS-015).

entries.label: Add
entries.reason: Profile-list CRUD (duplicate/create a new, user-named profile). Lulo ships the Mac's 12 fixed named profiles (TERM-12) rather than user-created ones; adding create/duplicate without a colour-well editor to go with it (see the Background/ANSI-colour rows) wouldn't let a user do anything useful with the new profile (TRM-SETTINGS-002).

entries.label: Remove
entries.reason: Profile-list CRUD for user-created profiles; see "Add" above — Lulo has no user-created profiles to remove (TRM-SETTINGS-017).

entries.label: Default
entries.reason: Sets the selected row as the application's default profile. Lulo's Settings window already does exactly this the moment a profile row is clicked (`set_default_profile`), so a separate "Default" button would duplicate existing behaviour rather than add a distinct action the exported-control scanner should count twice (TRM-SETTINGS-011).

entries.label: Advanced
entries.reason: One of the Mac profile editor's six inner panes (Text/Window/Tab/Shell/Keyboard/Advanced). Lulo's Settings window already has Text/Window/Shell/Keyboard/General sections; tests/inventory/mac/Terminal.json's accessibility capture only ever expanded the Text pane's own controls, so there is no recorded Mac truth for what Advanced actually contains to build against (TRM-SETTINGS-003).

entries.label: Tab
entries.reason: The Mac profile editor's "Tab" pane (tab-bar title/appearance options), not captured in tests/inventory/mac/Terminal.json beyond its own name — see "Advanced" above (TRM-SETTINGS-019).

entries.label: Window Groups
entries.reason: Saved/restorable sets of Terminal windows (Window ▸ Save Windows as Group…). Tracked as unimplemented in docs/parity.md TERM-17/TERM-15; this is the Settings window's tab for managing those same saved groups, so it has the same dependency (TRM-SETTINGS-020).
